title: QUIC RFC 9312 Manageability Diagnostics Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, qlog diagnostic mapping tests, runtime NAT-rebinding/path-validation diagnostic tests, local close diagnostic tests, solution build, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers the metadata-only RFC 9312 diagnostics added in this slice: packet header form/type, coalesced datagram packet count, connection ID lifecycle, path validation and migration promotion, spin bit state, ICMP Packet Too Big, PMTU updates, close/draining state, UDP errors, anti-amplification blocking, and stateless reset qlog mapping.
preconditions: RFC 9312 remains classified as informational manageability guidance.
The transport already owns the RFC 9000 wire-image, migration, PMTU, close, stateless reset, and spin-bit behavior.
Diagnostics remain disabled unless an enabled diagnostics sink is supplied.
The qlog adapter remains outside the transport core.
expected_result: The solution builds, focused RFC9312 tests pass, qlog mappings include the new metadata-only events, core SpecTrace validation accepts the new artifacts, generated requirement coverage includes the RFC9312 manageability family, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Focused RFC9312 verification passed in this branch: the solution build passed, focused RFC9312 requirement-home tests passed 6/6; the combined RFC9308/RFC9312 focused filter passed 18/18; the qlog smoke filter passed 7/7; core SpecTrace validation accepted 619 JSON artifacts; generated coverage reports RFC9312 at 5/5 trace clean.
